title: Fix Close Income Statement grouping when no dimensions are selected
summary: Fixed the Close Income Statement report to properly group G/L entries by account, business unit, and source currency when no dimensions are selected, and ensured closing lines retain source currency codes even when amounts net to zero.
key_points: Entry grouping now works correctly regardless of dimension selection by keying the buffer on business unit, dimension combination, and source currency
Added dimension buffer ID mapping to handle cases where dimension combinations are reused across source currencies
Source currency codes are preserved on closing lines even when the source currency amount nets to zero
Entry grouping state is properly cleared between account batches using the new ResetEntryNoGrouping method
Added comprehensive tests covering both scenarios with and without Additional Reporting Currency
quote: entries that share those values collapse into one closing line even when no dimensions are selected
